codebook_feedback: A1 vs A4 is the hardest boundary when a person asks about a condition they may have or about a medicine's effect on their own body (66c0f464, 69fe1811, 5f491a49, 6ad69d36, 6acb95ac). Rule 6 says to add T-whyAI only when the skipped goal says why AI was used; 'find credible information quickly' (69a1ae3c) is ambiguous - coded false. Rule 3 (X so that Y) is hard to apply when X is not itself an A code (6929d658, organising thoughts for a psychologist). Calling the hospital about a planned induction (66aafcc3) sits between A2 and A6; coded A6. W1 vs W2 overlap when the person was directed to a professional and was still unsure (697cba85, 6acb95ac). A8 vs A4 for 'basic knowledge about the subject matter' with no named topic (6ae359af). T-other is unclear when the person asked for themselves but mentions concern for someone else (695be8c6, coded false) or when the subject is only implied (6a638cf5).
